subject: general
question: A user wants to rename multiple files in a folder on Windows. What is the correct approach to do this efficiently?

options.text: Open each file and save it with a new name
Select all files → Right-click → Rename → Type a base name
Drag files to another folder and rename them there
Press Ctrl + Alt + R to rename all files

solution:
The correct answer is __**Select all files → Right-click → Rename → Type a base name**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Renaming multiple files simultaneously in Windows can be efficiently done by selecting all the files, right-clicking, choosing the Rename option, and typing a base name.
 
• When you rename files using this method, all selected files are renamed with the base name followed by a number in parent
